title: Milei Signs Decree to Deport Foreigners Who 'Spread Hate' of Argentina
detail: President Milei signed an emergency decree empowering the government to bar entry to or expel foreign nationals it deems to be spreading 'hate' or disinformation about Argentina. The decree follows days of government claims that an 'anti-Argentina' campaign circulated on social media during the country's run in the 2026 FIFA World Cup, after accusations of racism and unsporting conduct involving Argentine players and fans drew international criticism. Legal experts have questioned the measure's constitutionality, noting it grants broad discretionary power to the executive over speech-related immigration enforcement.

media.caption: Milei signs decree targeting foreigners accused of spreading 'hate' of Argentina
